title: Ambush in the Redfang woods
changes: Redfang bandits now hide up in the trees along the trails around their camp. You won't see them until you walk right under them.
When you do, they drop out of the branches and land beside you with a stab, and the rest of their group jumps down after them.
Once the fight is over, any survivors climb back up into the trees and wait for the next traveller.
